messages:
Ibrahim Khan: hi folks, day 2 here. trying to get cloud access for the onboarding tutorial. filled the cloud access form but it failed on Billing Account validation. also need AWS dev assume-role and access to `us-west-2`. any quick checklist? :slightly_smiling_face:
Nina Park: welcome Ibrahim! :wave: Common issues: Billing ID needs dashes like `012345-678901-234567`. Also ensure the email you used matches our SSO. Which GCP project name do you want?
Ibrahim Khan: thanks Nina. project id `redwood-onboard-ibrahim`. Billing ID I entered was `012345678901234567` (no dashes)  will resend with dashes. For AWS my SSO email is ibrahim.khan@redwood.ai  do I need any manual invite?
Nina Park: if SSO already provisioned you should see the AWS account in Workforce SSO. If not, tell me and I'll add you. I'll attach the billing account and create the GCP project. For roles, I'll grant `roles/browser`, `roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1`, and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`.
infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-9987 opened by nina for project redwood-onboard-ibrahim. ETA: 25m.
ops-sre: FYI dev accounts are restricted to `us-west-2` and `eu-west-1`. If you need ap-southeast-1 request via cloud-compliance with justification. Also file PROD access requests separately later.
Ibrahim Khan: got the invite for AWS, accepted. Nina  after billing attach I still see a KMS permission denied when the tutorial tries to decrypt a token. Key path in docs: `projects/redwood-common/locations/us/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-key`.
Nina Park: ah yes. I'll add you to `onboard-kms-users` group which has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. After that you can test with:
```
gcloud kms decrypt --location=us --keyring=onboard --key=onboard-key --ciphertext-file=c.bin --plaintext-file=p.txt
```
Ibrahim Khan: ran the gcloud test, works now. thanks for the quick turnaround! :tada:
Ibrahim Khan: one last q  where do I update cost center on the project? need it for internal billing tag.
Nina Park: open the billing settings on the project or ping finance with PROJECT: redwood-onboard-ibrahim and COST_CENTER: ENG-PLAT. They will tag it. Closing INFRA-9987 after billing fully attached.
